Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

xpam 1.0.0

First CRAN release. xpam consolidates the GitHub-only 0.1.0–0.3.0 line into a single, reviewed submission: the small-input dense path (get_geo_pam()) plus the streaming native engine, the sparse incidence surface and the native Jaccard backend described under 0.3.0 below.

Submission preparation

  • Documentation and vignettes are published on the package website (https://alrobles.github.io/xpam/) rather than shipped in the CRAN tarball; vignettes/ and inst/doc/ are excluded from the build (.Rbuildignore), and the VignetteBuilder field was dropped so the source package carries no prebuilt vignette index. README.md and NEWS.md are now shipped in the tarball.
  • Examples that touch remote data (get_rodentia_mexico(), get_world_pca(), and the downloaded example in get_geo_pam()) are guarded: the functions document and honour a "Can't access data." character return when the data server is unreachable, and the examples test for it, so R CMD check --run-donttest passes offline. The get_geo_pam() example additionally runs a fully local SpatVector example that needs no download at all.
  • GDAL remains optional: configure detects it and the native raster path links only when it is present; without GDAL the package installs, loads and the terra-based fallback works. Engine tests are skipped when GDAL is absent.
  • Network-dependent tests are gated with skip_on_cran() + skip_if_offline().

Engine and API (carried from 0.3.0)

  • pam_env_engine() streaming environmental PAM; pam_incidence() sparse incidence (Matrix::dgCMatrix or i/j triplets); pam_jaccard() species- or site-wise Jaccard with an optional exact thresholded edge list; pam_env() dense small-input environmental path; has_gdal() build-time capability report.
  • Occurrence sources: in-memory pairs, the XPOC binary pair file (xpam_write_occ_bin()), and GDAL/OGR vector sources – single paths, vectors of paths, directories (k-way merged and deduplicated) or in-memory terra::SpatVectors.
  • OpenMP regions honour OMP_THREAD_LIMIT.

xpam 0.3.0

The engine release: xpam is now a standalone high-performance PAM package — streamed incidence construction, a sparse PAM surface, and a native Jaccard backend, on top of the original get_geo_pam() API.

Streaming engine core

  • New pam_env_engine(): builds the environmental PAM straight from raster files. A PamEngine C++ object (opaque XPtr) owns GDAL I/O and all computation; R passes only paths, the (species, cell) table and scalars. Full-width strips are read into a pixel-major buffer, each cell is binned by GridBinning, and pairs – pre-sorted by cell – merge-join the strips in a single pass into PamBitset. Memory is O(bitset + strip); max_bitset_mb triggers the sort fallback as in pam_env(). Requires GDAL at build time (has_gdal() reports it); configure degrades gracefully without it. Raster cells are terra cellnumbers (1-based).
  • PamBitset rows are word-aligned (<= 63 pad bits per species), so pairwise kernels do popcount(A & B)/popcount(A | B) per row pair via the row() accessor.
  • Parallel regions honour OMP_THREAD_LIMIT (via pam::safe_threads()); CRAN check machines set it to 2 and omp_get_max_threads() alone does not respect it.

Occurrence sources

  • occ: data frame of (cell, species) — SEXP-anchored, sorted once (MemOccSource).
  • occ_file: cell-sorted “XPOC” binary pair file streamed in ~48 MiB chunks (FileOccSource); xpam_write_occ_bin() writes it. At 4e6 cells x 500 species the streamed path cuts RSS from ~3.1 GB to ~0.6 GB.
  • occ_polygons: GDAL/OGR vector sources rasterised in bounded tiles by PolygonOccSource (GDALRasterizeGeometries into a per-feature MEM window) — no dense raster, no materialised pair table. Accepts:
    • a path (shapefile, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, … or an OGR connection string such as duckdb:///db.duckdb when the GDAL build has the driver),
    • a character vector of paths, or a directory scanned for vector files — the per-dataset cell-sorted streams are k-way merged and deduplicated (MergeOccSource); species is then required,
    • an in-memory terra::SpatVector (bridged through a temporary GeoPackage). poly_layer takes one name per dataset or a single name applied to all; all_touched selects the burn rule; occ_dump tees the stream the engine consumes — merged and deduplicated — into a reusable XPOC file (DumpOccSource).
  • Polygon SRS is reprojected to the env raster CRS when they differ; features with missing/unmatched fields or unusable geometries are counted and reported via n_skipped (+ warning).

Sparse incidence surface

  • New pam_incidence(): the PAM itself as an R object. Streams any occurrence source through the engine and returns the units x species incidence as a Matrix::dgCMatrix (format = "dgCMatrix", Matrix in Suggests) or a raw data.frame(i, j) triplet table. space = "geo" is the streaming geographic PAM (raster cells as units, env files as grid template only — the scalable replacement for get_geo_pam()); space = "env" gives the environmental incidence over the same bins as pam_env_engine(). Explicit scale gates: incidence export needs the bitmap or sort accumulator (the geo co-occurrence path retains no pairs), and nnz * 16 B must fit max_out_mb to marshal to R — beyond that the on-disk XPOC from occ_dump is the sparse PAM.

Native Jaccard backend

  • pam_jaccard(): pairwise Jaccard similarity between species straight from any occurrence source — no dense PAM, no RcppParallel. space = "geo" uses raster cells as incidence units (env_files supplies only the grid template); space = "env" uses env bins. Accumulator: the shared bitset when n_species * n_units/8 fits max_bitset_mb; in geo space beyond the budget an O(n_species^2) co-occurrence matrix is accumulated from per-cell species runs of the cell-sorted pair stream (kernel = "cooc", counts returned as cooc). Semantics port fastJaccard::jaccard_fast: J = |A&B| / |A|B|, independence expectation pa*pb/(pa+pb-pa*pb) on empty unions, centered = TRUE subtracts the expectation.
  • pam_jaccard(threshold = tau) returns the similarity graph instead of the matrix: an exact prefix-filtered join (AllPairs-style — rare-first prefix indexing, size and count bounds, exact merge-join verification) emits the edges data.frame (i, j, J >= tau) with output-sensitive work. Same results as filtering the dense matrix; works for both by modes and all accumulators. On a 2,000-species x 20k-cell fixture it is ~80-280x faster than fastJaccard’s dense RcppParallel path and needs no 305 MB input matrix (benchmarks/docs/bench_jaccard.md).
  • pam_jaccard(by = "site") transposes the question: an n_units x n_units matrix of similarities between cells or env bins over the species they share. Requires the transposed bitset within max_bitset_mb and the dense n_units^2 return within max_out_mb (default 4096 MB, ~22.6k units).

Package changes

  • Package renamed pam -> xpam: the name pam is already taken on CRAN. Headers live in src/*.h (not .hpp) because R CMD check flags unlikely file names in src/ as a WARNING.
  • Internal refactor: the kernel’s heavy state moved to pure-C++ headers (pam_bitset.h, pam_binning.h, pam_accumulate.h, pam_threads.h) with no Rcpp dependency; SystemRequirements raised to C++17.
  • New c_bin_assign_d(): D-dimensional grid binning over a matrix.
  • pam_env() gains a max_bitset_mb memory budget and reports the kernel used; accumulation fills a single shared bitset with lock-free atomic ORs; out-of-range (species, bin) codes are counted and warned.
  • xpam_sim_env() / xpam_sim_ranges() / xpam_truth() / xpam_niche_bound(): internal deterministic generators and a transparent R-only oracle used to validate the engine (test-pam_sim.R).
  • configure hardened: LIBS is cleared before probing and the GDAL link test uses only gdal-config --libs, so ambient environment libraries (e.g. a user ~/.R/Makevars exporting -lRcppParallel into R CMD INSTALL’s environment) can no longer silently disable GDAL. AC_PROG_CXX is also resolved before the link test instead of lazily inside it.
  • Fixed url_exists() returning TRUE for unresolvable hosts.
  • Benchmarks: benchmarks/docs/bench_engine.md (incl. the 1/120-degree global sweep: 22.5e9 pairs streamed, ~15-24 GB RSS) and benchmarks/docs/bench_jaccard.md.

xpam 0.2.0

  • DESCRIPTION overhauled: Authors@R format, CRAN-quality title and description, BugReports URL, Suggests for testthat/knitr/rmarkdown.
  • Replaced httr/stringr/magrittr dependencies with base R equivalents; added checkmate for input validation.
  • Switched from magrittr pipe (%>%) to base R pipe (|>). Minimum R version raised to 4.1.0.
  • Added checkmate::assert_* guards in get_geo_pam() and url_exists().
  • Roxygen documentation rewritten for all exported and internal functions.
  • Added testthat test suite (tests/testthat/).
  • Added introductory vignette (vignettes/pam-intro.Rmd).
  • Added NEWS.md.
  • Added R CMD check CI workflow (ubuntu, macOS, windows).
  • Fixed get_rodentia_mexico() docstring (was incorrectly labelled “afrosoricida”).

xpam 0.1.0

  • Initial release with get_geo_pam(), get_rodentia_mexico(), and get_world_pca().
